adjudicated.jp: 大人しかった蝉たちが、再びじわじわと鳴きはじめる。

comments: With the implication that the cicadas are not always crying. How much of this is to troll the first-time reader and how much of this is to troll further readers isn't so obvious, but I suspect it's strongly for the latter as well. -GHS
adjudicated.assessment: The source says cicadas that had quieted down gradually begin chirping again. 'Docile' means obedient, and 'being their cry' is grammatically incoherent.
adjudicated.remedy: Use 'The cicadas, quiet until now, gradually begin chirping again.'

adjudicated.assessment: The English preserves the source's propositional content and local pragmatic function without a material addition, omission, or role reversal.

adjudicated.jp: 「外見はいいとこもあるんだろうけど、欠点がバリバリ見えるから、たいしてきれいなモンにゃ思えないって感じか？」
adjudicated.en: Shinkawa: "For the outwards she's fine for sure, but, after those weak points tear through that nice and clean, I can't really think of 'er as something pretty can I?"
comments: See CCC3004. That's the majority of how we see her treat her precious onii-chan. Sure, she's tsundere, but, damn. -GHS
adjudicated.assessment: The clause is incoherent. The source says her good looks are offset by glaring flaws, so he cannot see her as especially beautiful.
adjudicated.remedy: Use 'She may look good, but her flaws are so obvious that I can't think of her as especially beautiful.'

highlights.text: after those weak points tear through that nice and clean

adjudicated.jp: 「食うものは食うし、出すものは―――」
adjudicated.en: Shinkawa: "What's for eating you eat, what's for expelling---"
comments: This sounds less scatological and more creepy considering the whole 'devour' metaphor. -GHS
adjudicated.assessment: The source says she eats and excretes like anyone else. The English shifts to generic second person and forms neither clause idiomatically.
adjudicated.remedy: Use 'She eats, and what goes in has to come—'

highlights.text: What's for eating you eat, what's for expelling

adjudicated.jp: 「あ、その先はいいや。夢は大事にしたい」
adjudicated.en: Taichi: "Ah, that's enough with that. I wanna keep my precious dream."
adjudicated.assessment: The English preserves the source's propositional content and local pragmatic function without a material addition, omission, or role reversal.

adjudicated.jp: 「……おまえの夢って」
adjudicated.en: Shinkawa: "...your dream you say?"
adjudicated.assessment: The English preserves the source's propositional content and local pragmatic function without a material addition, omission, or role reversal.

adjudicated.jp: 「ぜひおまえとチェンジして姪子ちゃんとイチャイチャしたいものだ」
adjudicated.en: Taichi: "Wanting to completely replace you and getting all kissy-kissy with your niecey-chan, of course."
comments: It sounds like foreshadowing, until realizing Taichi doesn't believe Yutaka for one second. This is an accusation. -GHS
adjudicated.assessment: The source states Taichi's wish to switch places with Shinkawa. The English is a gerund fragment, and 'completely replace you' can imply erasing the person rather than trading roles.
adjudicated.remedy: Use 'I'd love to trade places with you and get cozy with your niece.'

adjudicated.jp: 「うわ－、想像させるな気持ち悪い」
adjudicated.en: Shinkawa: "Blaaargh, don't make me imagine that, how disgusting!"
adjudicated.assessment: The English preserves the source's propositional content and local pragmatic function without a material addition, omission, or role reversal.

adjudicated.jp: 「現実は駄目だ……」
adjudicated.en: Taichi: "Reality is a waste..."
comments: No no no, you mean 'RIAJUU is KUSOGE-desu'. -GHS
adjudicated.assessment: The source says reality is no good or unacceptable. Calling it a waste introduces a different evaluation.
adjudicated.remedy: Use 'Reality is no good...'

adjudicated.jp: 本気で気持ち悪がってるよ、この人。
adjudicated.en: This guy's really disgusted!
adjudicated.assessment: The English preserves the source's propositional content and local pragmatic function without a material addition, omission, or role reversal.

adjudicated.jp: エロ小説万歳。
adjudicated.en: Ero LN banzai.
comments: Damn straight! Fuck eroge! ...though I'm tempted to replace it with the console version's 二次元万歳 (2D banzai). This is Taichi not understanding that he's understood. It's self-troll, not troll. -GHS
adjudicated.assessment: The source celebrates erotic novels. The English narrows novels to light novels and leaves the celebratory word untranslated as Japanese apparatus.
adjudicated.remedy: Use 'Long live erotic novels.'

adjudicated.jp: 「じゃまた今度にでも遊びに来てくれ」
adjudicated.en: Taichi: "Well, maybe sometime I'll drop in to visit if you'll have me."
adjudicated.assessment: The source has Taichi invite Shinkawa to visit him another time. The English reverses visitor and host, making Taichi promise to visit Shinkawa.
adjudicated.remedy: Use 'Come visit me sometime.'

adjudicated.jp: そう言ったやつの目がテポドン級の節穴であることが、後に明らかになるのである。
adjudicated.en: How the guy who said this will be shown to have Taepodong-class knothole eyes will become clear afterwards.
comments: It's indeed the missile, which fits into the Nations of the World thing - "he has rockets big enough to threaten Japan", except it's not a sexual metaphor (somehow). but this refers to a type of creepy dolls called 'murder dolls' (殺人人形), who have eyes like knotholes. Chucky from Child's Play seems to be among the most popular, curiously. This ties to Taichi's backstory as a human doll, automatic behavior, Taichi's own eyes, and more. -GHS
adjudicated.assessment: The doubled future construction is ungrammatical and the literal 'knothole eyes' does not convey the idiom for spectacular blindness or bad judgment.
adjudicated.remedy: Use 'It would later become clear that his judgment was blind on a Taepodong scale.'

highlights.text: How the guy who said this will be shown to have Taepodong-class knothole eyes will become clear afterwards

withheld.jp: 「そんなのうそだーっ！　おまえはうそつきだ！　可愛い年下の親族がいるんだぞ？　意識しないはずないじゃないか！　おまえは仏国書院の一冊も読まないのか！？　ありえねー！　解せねー！　よっておまえがうそつきだと証明された！」
withheld.en: Taichi: "That is nothing but a LIEEE! You are a LIAR! You have a cute younger relative, get it? You can't be unaware of that can't you! Didn't you read even one book from that French publishing house?! Impossible! Unbelievable! You are a liar and that was the proof!"
comments: Ryugu Taichi is in the house. Well, except he's not going off on him at random. also stop reading shoujo FFS. -GHS
